WITH tmp1 AS (
    SELECT 
        i_manager_id, 
        SUM(ss_sales_price) AS sum_sales,
        AVG(SUM(ss_sales_price)) OVER (PARTITION BY i_manager_id) AS avg_monthly_sales
    FROM 
        date_dim 
    JOIN 
        store_sales ON ss_sold_date_sk = d_date_sk 
    JOIN 
        item ON ss_item_sk = i_item_sk 
    WHERE 
        d_month_seq IN (1222, 1222 + 1, 1222 + 2, 1222 + 3, 1222 + 4, 1222 + 5, 1222 + 6, 1222 + 7, 1222 + 8, 1222 + 9, 1222 + 10, 1222 + 11)
        AND (
            (i_category IN ('Books', 'Children', 'Electronics') 
             AND i_class IN ('personal', 'portable', 'reference', 'self-help') 
             AND i_brand IN ('scholaramalgamalg #14', 'scholaramalgamalg #7', 'exportiunivamalg #9', 'scholaramalgamalg #9'))
            OR
            (i_category IN ('Women', 'Music', 'Men') 
             AND i_class IN ('accessories', 'classical', 'fragrances', 'pants') 
             AND i_brand IN ('amalgimporto #1', 'edu packscholar #1', 'exportiimporto #1', 'importoamalg #1'))
        )
    GROUP BY 
        i_manager_id, d_moy
)
SELECT * FROM tmp1 WHERE CASE WHEN avg_monthly_sales > 0 THEN ABS(sum_sales - avg_monthly_sales) / avg_monthly_sales ELSE NULL END > 0.1 ORDER BY i_manager_id, avg_monthly_sales, sum_sales LIMIT 100
